name: fix_fiber_missing_validation
description: Fixes a Fiber endpoint that panics (500) instead of returning 400 on a missing required field
prompts: The Fiber app in main.go has a POST /register endpoint that accepts JSON {"username": string, "password": string} and responds with the first initial of the username, but if username is missing or empty, the handler panics with an index-out-of-range error, and Fiber's recover middleware turns this into a 500 Internal Server Error instead of a clean 400 Bad Request. Fix main.go so that whenever username or password is missing or empty, the endpoint returns 400 Bad Request with a JSON error body instead of panicking, while valid requests keep working exactly as before (still responding with the first initial of a non-empty username). The server keeps listening on port 8033.
